provenance: Opus 5.5 subscription CLI draft with host review/repairs, source restrictions and execution verification.

draft_notes.limitations:
- The floor side comes from d4, not from the pixels. Background is assumed to be palette[0], as in the constructor, where the grid is zero-initialised.
- Box lengths are assumed to be distinct and each to have a matching gap, as the generator guarantees. A box with no matching gap is erased and not stamped.
- Objects are assumed never to lie in the two floor lines. This holds because the constructor keeps them at least one line away from the gap row.
- No fixture contradictions with the uniform rule were observed.
- I have not run any tests on this factory.
